dct_description_sm:
Overview

This feature service provides the mapped boundaries of the District of Peachland's aquatic sensitive area development permit designation. It supports local planning and land use review by identifying areas subject to aquatic environmental considerations within the district.

Feature Layers

  • Aquatic Development Permit Area (PCH) — Polygon features defining the aquatic development permit area boundaries used for planning, development review, and environmental management in Peachland.

Geographic Coverage

The service covers the District of Peachland in British Columbia, with extent focused on the community and surrounding lands where the aquatic development permit area applies.

Use Cases

  • Municipal development permit review
  • Land use planning and zoning support
  • Environmental and aquatic habitat consideration in project screening
  • Public reference for regulated development areas

Source and Use

Owned by District of Peachland, distributed under the Regional District of Central Okanagan open data license and disclaimer terms.
